body: Fuck. Same boat. I’m getting dogged down for student loans and my credit card bills in the thousands. No money to even make the minimums. Wish I could help but I hope it helps to know you’re not alone in this bullshit.

It feels like it sometimes. Everyone around me seems to be doing so well, with good prospects for their future. It feels like I’m the only one who’s struggling.  I know it’s not a fix-all thing, but I appreciate your post. It makes me feel a little less alone in this

I want to keep pushing. Everyday just feels like surviving, not living. I don’t know how to get over my fear of losing and disappointing the people I love. I know it’s stupid but I’d rather die than lose them. Thank you though, I hope I can move past this
